segments.name: AI Services
segments.description: Single reportable segment covering AI services for enterprises, technology licensing, advertising and cross-border consumer-goods trading.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that there is only one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Licensees pay royalties for matchmaking technology, and clients pay for advertising campaigns and AI data services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our technology licensing business generated royalties of $7.3 million in our financial year ended April 30, 2026.

changes.text: In 2024 the company agreed to sell Slinger Bag Americas Inc. as part of the YYEM acquisition.
changes.evidence: As part of the transaction, the Company agreed to sell its wholly owned subsidiary, Slinger Bag Americas Inc., to a newly established Florida limited liability company owned by members of the Company's prior management team.
